title: 写入流水线复制（pipeline）：客户端只发一份
expected_output:
pipeline: client -> dn1 -> dn2 -> dn3
client_sent_once: PKT#01
acks: ['dn1:received', 'dn2:received', 'dn3:received']
all_ack_ok: True
client_transmitted_copies: 1
code:
pipeline = ["client", "dn1", "dn2", "dn3"]
packet = "PKT#01"
acks = []
for node in pipeline[1:]:
    acks.append(node + ":received")
print("pipeline:", " -> ".join(pipeline))
print("client_sent_once:", packet)
print("acks:", acks)
print("all_ack_ok:", len(acks) == len(pipeline) - 1)
print("client_transmitted_copies:", 1)
